name: optitrack
description: OptiTrack - Gestión Integral de Cadenas de Ópticas, Contactología & Talleres de Tallado Oftálmico

scripts.version:bump: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const v = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('version.json', 'utf8')); const parts = v.version.slice(1).split('.'); parts[2] = String(Number(parts[2]) + 1).padStart(2, '0'); v.version = 'v' + parts.join('.'); fs.writeFileSync('version.json', JSON.stringify(v, null, 2) + '\n'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); pkg.version = v.version.slice(1); fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n'); const sw = fs.readFileSync('sw.js', 'utf8').replace(/optitrack-cache-v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+/g, 'optitrack-cache-' + v.version); fs.writeFileSync('sw.js', sw); console.log('Bumped to', v.version);"
